mapper.sql: id,`name`, `type`, description,is_deleted, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by
mapper.select: select * from `data` where dataset_id =#{id} AND is_deleted=0 ORDER BY name ASC limit 6;
select count(*) from `data` d inner join data_annotation_object dao on d.id = dao.data_id where d.dataset_id = #{datasetId} and d.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT mine_name AS mineName, COUNT(DISTINCT dataset_id) AS datasetAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN data_type = 'SCENE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clipAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN data_type = 'SINGLE_DATA' AND annotation_status = 'ANNOTATED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS annotatedDataAmount FROM ( SELECT ds.id AS dataset_id, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ds.name, '/', 3), '/', -1) AS mine_name, d.type AS data_type, d.annotation_status FROM dataset ds LEFT JOIN data d ON d.dataset_id = ds.id AND d.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE ds.is_deleted = FALSE AND ds.name LIKE CONCAT(#{sourceName}, '/%') ) source_data GROUP BY mine_name ORDER BY mine_name

SELECT dc.name AS className, MAX(dc.color) AS color, COUNT(*) AS objectAmount FROM data_annotation_object dao INNER JOIN dataset_class dc ON dc.id = dao.class_id INNER JOIN dataset ds ON ds.id = dao.dataset_id INNER JOIN data d ON d.id = dao.data_id WHERE ds.is_deleted = FALSE AND d.is_deleted = FALSE AND d.annotation_status = 'ANNOTATED' AND ds.name LIKE CONCAT(#{sourceName}, '/%') GROUP BY dc.name ORDER BY objectAmount DESC

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ds.name, '/', 3), '/', -1) AS mineName, dc.name AS className, MAX(dc.color) AS color, COUNT(*) AS objectAmount FROM data_annotation_object dao INNER JOIN dataset_class dc ON dc.id = dao.class_id INNER JOIN dataset ds ON ds.id = dao.dataset_id INNER JOIN data d ON d.id = dao.data_id WHERE ds.is_deleted = FALSE AND d.is_deleted = FALSE AND d.annotation_status = 'ANNOTATED' AND ds.name LIKE CONCAT(#{sourceName}, '/%') GROUP BY mineName, dc.name ORDER BY mineName, objectAmount DESC

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ds.name, '/', 3), '/', -1) AS mineName, dsa.category, dsa.sub_type AS subType, COUNT(*) AS clipAmount FROM data_scene_attribute dsa INNER JOIN dataset ds ON ds.id = dsa.dataset_id INNER JOIN data d ON d.id = dsa.data_id WHERE ds.is_deleted = FALSE AND d.is_deleted = FALSE AND ds.name LIKE CONCAT(#{sourceName}, '/%') GROUP BY mineName, dsa.category, dsa.sub_type ORDER BY mineName, clipAmount DESC
mapper.delete: update dataset set del_unique_key = id, is_deleted = true where id = #{id}
